description: One persisted turn of the Issue Tracker AI Assistant conversation. A user + assistant pair is grouped by `sessionId`; the page loads every message for the current session on mount and appends on each send.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.description: Conversation thread id. One session per user for now; reserved for future multi-thread history.

fields.name: actionsJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded ChatAction[] for assistant messages (kept as a string to satisfy the schema's primitive field types).
